title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals
summary: Calculate the sum of XOR totals for all subsets of an array.
statement: Calculate the sum of XOR totals for all subsets of an array. The XOR total of a subset is the result of bitwise XOR on all its elements, or 0 if the subset is empty. Each subset, including duplicates, must be considered.
constraints: Index-distinct subsets are counted separately even when their values match.
hints: At each index a subset either excludes or includes that value.
Carry the current XOR down both branches of a recursion tree.
At the base case return the accumulated XOR; add both branch totals while unwinding.
Every subset corresponds to exactly one sequence of include/exclude choices, so the leaves enumerate all index-distinct subsets once.

tests.explanation: The subset XOR totals are 0, 1, 3, and 2, which sum to six.
The eight subset XOR totals sum to twenty-eight.
